title: CeeDee Lamb's Record 2023: 135 Catches and Cowboys History
question: What Dallas Cowboys records does former Sooner CeeDee Lamb hold?
answer: CeeDee Lamb (OU 2017-19) holds the Cowboys' single-season records for receptions (135) and receiving yards (1,749), both set in 2023, when he also became the first player in franchise history to lead the NFL in catches.
summary: Ex-Sooner CeeDee Lamb set Cowboys single-season records with 135 catches and 1,749 yards in 2023, breaking Michael Irvin's marks. His OU and NFL story.
body: CeeDee Lamb (OU 2017-19) was a highlight reel in crimson and cream. Over three seasons he caught 173 passes for 3,292 yards and 32 touchdowns, and in 2019 he was a consensus All-American, first-team All-Big 12 and the Most Outstanding Player of the Big 12 Championship Game.

The Dallas Cowboys took him 17th overall in 2020, and by 2023 he had produced one of the great receiving seasons in franchise history. Late that year against Detroit he passed both of Michael Irvin's 1995 club records, the 111 catches and 1,603 yards that had stood for nearly three decades.

Lamb was not finished. In the regular-season finale at Washington, a 38-10 win that clinched the NFC East, he caught all 13 passes thrown his way for 98 yards and two touchdowns. That pushed his season to 135 receptions, 1,749 yards and 12 touchdowns, and his league-leading catch total made him the first Cowboy ever to top the NFL in receptions. He was named a first-team AP All-Pro for the first time after earning second-team honors in 2022.

The consistency has been just as impressive. Lamb made five Pro Bowls covering the 2021 through 2025 seasons, and his fifth straight 1,000-yard season in 2025 tied Irvin for the longest such streak in team history.
For Sooner fans, it is a fun bit of trivia: the record book in Dallas now has an OU receiver's name at the top of both major single-season receiving categories.
